propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh shell script must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point maintaining exact behavioral parity on input (CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) -> output in {success, failure, cancelled}.

tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py contract test must be re-pointed from subprocess call to the shell script to the new Python entry point, preserving all existing test cases and adding direct in-process unit tests.
.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml must update sparse-checkout to fetch the new .py file path instead of the .sh file, and update the run invocation to call the Python entry point.

Python entry point must handle fail-closed mappings: empty CONCLUSION -> failure, unrecognized values -> failure, skipped with FAILURE_OBSERVED=true -> failure, skipped with FAILURE_OBSERVED=false -> success, and pass-through rows (success/failure/cancelled unchanged).
Shell script file must be deleted in the same change to prevent orphaned test references.
Python entry point must require no external dependencies beyond stdlib so a single-file sparse-checkout deployment works without package installation.
